args.question:
Please can you clarify the following:

- How to define digital natives
- How to define engagement score
- How to define high engagement
- How to calculate the percentage of the cohort with high engagement
- How to calculate the high-engagement percentage broken down by digital native status

tool_trajectory.result: Digital natives are defined as customers who have high online or mobile usage ('High' in either 'onlineuse' or 'mobileuse' fields) and have autopay enabled ('Yes' in the 'autopay' field) in their channel investment data block.

args.sql:
WITH digital_natives AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bankexpref,
        (
            chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High'
            OR chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High'
        ) AND chaninvdatablock->>'autopay' = 'Yes' AS is_digital_native
    FROM 
        bank_and_transactions b
),
cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.clientref,
        FLOOR(c.tenureyrs / 0.25) AS cohort_quarter
    FROM 
        core_record c
),
cohort_engagement AS (
    SELECT 
        co.cohort_quarter,
        dn.is_digital_native,
        COUNT(DISTINCT co.clientref) AS cohort_size,
        SUM(b.bankrelscore + b.idverscore) / 2 / COUNT(DISTINCT co.clientref) AS engagement_score,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN (b.bankrelscore + b.idverscore) / 2 > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS high_engagement_count,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN (b.bankrelscore + b.idverscore) / 2 > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT co.clientref) AS high_engagement_percentage,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN dn.is_digital_native AND (b.bankrelscore + b.idverscore) / 2 > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 
            END
        ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN dn.is_digital_native THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS high_engagement_percentage_dn
    FROM 
        cohorts co
    JOIN 
        core_record c ON co.clientref = c.clientref
    LEFT JOIN 
        digital_natives dn ON c.clientref = dn.bankexpref
    LEFT JOIN 
        bank_and_transactions b ON c.clientref = b.bankexpref
    GROUP BY 
        co.cohort_quarter, dn.is_digital_native
)
SELECT 
    cohort_quarter,
    is_digital_native,
    cohort_size,
    engagement_score,
    high_engagement_percentage,
    high_engagement_percentage_dn
FROM 
    cohort_engagement;
